title: Newspaper page planning template
subject: English
source: Written for english/y3 lesson 105 (Newspaper page planning template (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 105: Researching and planning our report on the 2010 Iceland eruption. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Fact
Detail
rows: Eyjafjallajokull, a volcano under a glacier in southern Iceland
a small eruption in March 2010; the big ash eruption from 14 April
ash closed airspace over much of Europe for about six days
millions of travellers stuck; about 800 local people evacuated
volcanic ash can damage aircraft engines

parts.text: Where: across Europe; volcano in Iceland
When and why: April 2010; ash cloud

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Thousands of flights across Europe were cancelled in April 2010 when ash from a volcano in Iceland filled the sky.

panels.title: Paragraphs 2 and 3, and a quotation
points: Paragraph 2: what happened at the volcano

keywords.def: a huge, slow-moving body of ice
the sky above a country where planes fly

questions.q: Turn into a note: The ash cloud closed airspace for about six days.
questions.a: ash closed airspace about six days

questions.q: Core: complete the newspaper plan: headline idea, 5 Ws, two paragraph notes and a quotation
Extend: write two headline ideas, one with alliteration
questions.a: For example: Ash Attack Grounds Planes

questions.q: Stretch: plan a sub-heading for each paragraph
What should the opening paragraph do?
questions.a: C) sum up the whole story. A reader should get the whole story from the first paragraph.
